hints.title: Greatest Common Divisor Definition
hints.text: For any contiguous slice, the common divisor monotonically decreases or stays unchanged as length expands.

hints.title: Upgrade Feasibility Check
hints.text: Doubling an element adds one factor of two; check how many elements bottleneck the factor of two.

hints.title: Evaluating Upgraded Divisor
hints.text: If at most k elements require doubling to double the common divisor, test the doubled product against current best.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Incremental common divisor accumulation across all subarray ranges.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all possible subsets of k doubled positions combinatorially explodes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterating endpoints directly requires minimal auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that the greatest common divisor can only double if the factor of two bottleneck fits within k doubling operations.
